description: Visual AsciiDoc editor for .adoc files in VS Code
config.language.description: Language of the Nota tab, of the remarks in the Problems panel and of the hints. `auto` (the default) follows the language of VS Code: Russian if VS Code is Russian, English otherwise. A change applies to the Problems panel at once, to an open tab after you close and reopen it. The names of the commands and of the editor follow the display language of VS Code, not this setting.
config.outlineView.description: How to show the «Sections» outline in a Nota tab. «Side» is a column of sections next to the text, always in view. If the tab is too narrow for the column, the capsule appears instead. «Capsule» is strips at the edge of the tab and a «Sections» capsule; the outline opens on hover or click.
config.outlineView.capsuleDescription: Strips at the edge of the tab and a «Sections» capsule; the outline opens on hover or click. The default.
config.outlineView.sideDescription: A column of sections next to the text, always in view; on a narrow tab, the capsule.
config.showAnchors.description: Show the lines with anchors (`[#id]`, `[[id]]`, `[id=…]`) above headings, paragraphs and admonitions in Visual mode: as a short mark, the full id in the tooltip on hover. Off by default: anchors are hidden, stay in the file as they were, and links to sections work. In Text mode anchors are always visible. A change applies to open tabs at once.
config.pageWidth.description: Width of the page in a Nota tab, in percent of the tab width: from 50 to 100, 85 by default. On a tab wider than 760 px a margin of at least 80 px always stays at the sides for block handles, table strips and «Sections», so at 100 % the page is a little narrower than the tab; on a tab up to 650 px the page takes the full width. A change applies to open tabs at once.
config.blocksInCapsule.description: Which blocks sit in the capsule when the tab is wide enough for the capsule to be expanded. «All blocks» is all 14 blocks as icons and list buttons. «Frequent blocks» is «Table», «Code», «Admonition», «Image» and lists; the rest are in the list under «+», so the capsule is shorter and stays expanded on narrower tabs. On a narrow tab the blocks are always under «+». A change applies to open tabs at once.
config.blocksInCapsule.allDescription: All 14 blocks as icons and list buttons. The default.
config.blocksInCapsule.frequentDescripti: «Table», «Code», «Admonition», «Image» and lists; the rest are under «+».
